s5fDesign.noNewFeatures: S5F adds NO new realtime features. It proves existing S5A-S5E infrastructure is resilient to disconnect/duplicate/reorder/multi-tab.
s5fDesign.reconnectContract: use-realtime.ts: reconnection=true, reconnectionAttempts=Infinity, reconnectionDelay=1000ms. On connect event, onReconnect callback fires → store refresh → REST reconciliation.
s5fDesign.dedupScoping: Per-instance LRU cache (S5D fix in use-social-realtime.ts). Each hook instance (NotificationBell, SocialScreen) gets its own dedup cache. No cross-hook suppression.
s5fDesign.blockAuthorization: enqueueLikeFanout + enqueueActivityFeedFanout query current SocialConnection ACCEPTED status at emit time. Blocked users (BLOCKED != ACCEPTED) excluded from fanout. Reconnect re-queries current DB truth.
s5fDesign.restAuthoritative: Every realtime event triggers REST refetch. Final state = latest committed DB state regardless of event delivery order, duplicates, or missed events.
